stances_toward.note: Constituent country since the dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles on 10 Oct 2010; foreign policy and defence are Kingdom affairs. Curaçao is the front line of the 2025-26 Venezuela crisis: the Netherlands denied the US use of its base for the 3 Jan 2026 operation, the armed forces chief said a US carrier lay under 100 km away and that the build-up far exceeds counter-drug needs, and the Dutch military intelligence service (April 2026) judged the US presence significantly expanded. Own territory, but with a local government whose consent the Charter requires for changes. Bond - kin.

relations_to.summary: The Kingdom holds and defends its Caribbean parts: foreign policy and defence are Kingdom affairs. In the 2025-26 Venezuela crisis the Dutch armed forces chief said a US carrier lay under 100 km from Curaçao and that the build-up far exceeds counter-drug needs; the government kept the Kingdom out of the US operation and denied the use of Curaçao.
